inicio.title: ORDER TO CHAOS
inicio.description1: Trying to become the new leader of the Cat Gang, Catuaba has put into practice a strategy to increase its influence: destabilize the Dog Armada. But their plans fell apart when the\nArmada discovered that the poop in the courtyard was actually feline!
inicio.description2:
Even with the culprit revealed, chaos ensued. Now, with
both groups in internal and external conflict, Nala and Valerius
see no alternative: it’s time to join forces to restore
peace. You must interfere in the confusion and put an end to this war -
 within groups and between species.

goal.title: Goal
goal.item1: Restore peace between Dogs and Cats by scoring 40 points or more at the end of a round.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Remove all point cards (they will not be used);
preparation.item2: Shuffle all other cards (except the poop cards) into a single deck;
preparation.item4: Give *1* poop card to each player;
preparation.item5: Shuffle the poop cards into the deck and form the Draw Pile;
preparation.item6: Keep the point tokens within reach of all players;
preparation.item7: Flip the first card from the pile to start the Discard Pile (referred to in cards as Yard or Sandbox).

generalRules.title: General rules
generalRules.item1: The game proceeds in turns, clockwise. The player who most recently interacted with both a cat and a dog in the same environment starts.

steps.1: 1. Discard one card from your hand.

generalRules.item3: Bonus: if the played card has the same value as the last card in the discard pile, the player may choose someone (including themselves) to draw a card.

endRound.title: End of round

steps.1: A player has 5 poop cards in hand;
steps.2: Or a player runs out of cat and dog cards in hand.
The new round starts with the player who triggered the end-of-round condition.

endRound.item3: In case of a tie, start with the player closest (to the left) of the last player.

item1.title: The game ends when a player reaches *40 or more points* at the end of a round.

steps.1: The player with the most points is declared the peacemaker of Etheria!
steps.2: In case of a tie, the player with the most points in the last round wins.
steps.3: If the tie continues, the players share the victory.
